table_row: A ends at 10; B starts at 12; no member lies between in the declared complete scope | Strict precedence; direct succession may hold despite the gap
narrative: A positive gap between A's end and B's start satisfies strict precedence (e_A < s_B) regardless of gap size. Whether direct succession also holds depends on whether the declared scope S is complete and contains no process strictly between A and B; the gap itself is never disqualifying.
